question: Six friends scored different marks in their annual psychology examination. Q scored more than exactly four friends. M scored more than exactly three friends. Both P and N scored more than T. Y scored the least marks. N is not the top scorer. Who scored the highest marks?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Q scored more than exactly four friends. 

__ > Q > __ > __ > __ > __

2) M scored more than exactly three friends.

__ > Q > M > __ > __ > __ 

3) Y scored the least marks.

__ > Q > M > __ > __ > Y

4) Both P and N scored more than T.

5) N is not the top scorer.

**P > Q > M > N > T > Y**

Here, we can see that P scored the highest marks.

Hence, the correct answer is **"P"**.
